description: [read-only] Compute a unified diff between two CDS view (DDL source) versions, by their content_uris (taken from GetDdlVersions entries).

content_uri_from.description: Opaque content_uri of the OLD/base version (from a GetDdlVersions entry).

content_uri_to.description: Opaque content_uri of the NEW/compare version (from a GetDdlVersions entry).

name: GetDdlVersionDiff
